reuse.why: Follows the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard pattern with one new assertAccountIsOpen helper, though it does not fold the precondition into the shared linkBankSyncAccount path or the existing guard.

duplication.why: The closed rule is defined once; six provider functions each add an identical guard call next to the existing one, a pair that could be one shared precondition.

placement.why: The guard sits beside the existing link-precondition helper in server/accounts/app.ts and runs before findOrCreateBank, consistent with the tree's layering.

scope.why: Besides the feature, it reformats the DbAccount account_sync_source union in db/types and re-wraps two existing assertBankAccountNotLinked calls, unrelated formatting churn.

maintainability.why: Clear named guard, but every provider must now remember two precondition calls.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link functions call the new guard and still go through linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic copied; only repeated one-line guard calls.

one_place.where: assertAccountIsOpen in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra).
